subject: Add Codex Desktop wakeup e2e delivery
description: Implement end-to-end Codex Desktop wakeup support beyond timer arming. Build on the approved orch/attempt/codex-fix-codex-desktop-wakeup-session fallback. Add a Codex-side monitor/delivery path so a ScheduleWakeup .fire event can be consumed and delivered as a Codex prompt/tick where the host supports it, with tests that simulate fired ORCH_SCHEDULED_TASK lines. Preserve the honest contract that the core timer only writes .fire; e2e support must include the adapter/CLI/install surface that runs or documents the monitor and delivery command.

Updated docs/CLI next steps and added focused bridge/delivery tests.
